truth_boundary: routing-only; the host tool trace is required for live proof

host.registry.export.reason: Codex Desktop exposes no authoritative host registry-export callable; use the non-attested current-session census initializer and retain all later live probes

image.provider.acquire.authority.reason: Codex Desktop exposes no optional provider-acquisition policy hook. This does not block current-session operational authoring: formal v2 assets use the completed migration plus canonical request, create-once ingestion, exact raw bytes, and RGBA pixel gates, with host_attested=false and portable=false. A future Python hook may veto but can never upgrade assurance; portable-signed assets still require separate verified Ed25519 receipts.

browser.download.ingest.truth_boundary: binds the current Browser trace identifiers to source/target byte hashes but does not sign or independently attest the browser event

wechat.draft.credential_policy: Execution-time credential and account identifier references are documented in runtime/non-mcp-dependencies.json and never stored in registry, profile, report, or URL; this CLI does not implement application-secret exchange

wechat.current-session-readback.truth_boundary: opens the exact API-saved draft in the current Browser session and binds real 390px PNG bytes to the API reread; it is neither browser-event attestation nor publication authority

wechat.current-session-authority.reason: The local WeChat draft API client is file-driven and cannot consume a fresh in-process user confirmation plus authoritative account/draft readback; wechat.draft never implies publication authority

host.receipt.attest.reason: Codex Desktop has no callable host receipt signer in this runtime; this blocks only a portable signed-audit claim. Draft work remains available. Publication requires an independent wechat.current-session-authority or a separately declared live UI route; the file-driven draft API is insufficient.

host.migration.finalize.reason: Codex Desktop has no host-owned migration finalizer/signing callable or replay ledger in this runtime

filesystem.access.lease.reason: Codex Desktop has no callable per-run filesystem lease that can enforce the source-zero allowlist and deny old organization/example/output state
